description: Deterministische Composite-Chain. Jeder Commit schreibt Composite + Mood + Narrator fort. Mood[N] != Mood[N-1] garantiert. Narrator deterministisch via n-Feld (1=Buffy, 2=Basher, 3=Thinker, 4=Vannon, 5=Squizzle, 6=Devin, 7=Argos, 8=Ghost, 9=Spark, 10=Glitch, 11=Null, 12=Echo, 13=Flux, 14=Sage). NEU: model_id + prev_narrator fuer Cross-Narrator-Referenzen in Commit-Dialogen.
